entities.name: Milan Čuda
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Milan Čuda was a Czech volleyball player who competed for Czechoslovakia in the 1964 Summer Olympics. He was part of the Czechoslovak team which won the silver medal in the Olympic tournament. He played two matches. Čuda and his 1964 teammate Boris Perušič are brothers-in-law.
